name: Potato Pie
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Puff pastry, rolled out ⅛ inch thick

steps: Peel and slice your potatoes very thin.
Layer the potatoes in a pie dish, adding some onion, salt, and pepper between each layer.
Add a dash of water to the potatoes, and scatter the chopped butter over top.
Cover the filling with the rolled-out puff pastry.
Bake at 375°F until golden and cooked through (about 1½ hours).
